verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Warp serves an llms.txt at docs.warp.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes its documentation. The pack also cites an llms-small.txt and many per-section _llms-txt/*.txt files (agents, CLI, automation platform, code), so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party docs explaining or promoting the llms.txt files for agent use, and independent or hands-on reports of agents consuming them successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Documentation for Warp, the agentic development environment.
The Automation Platform runs cloud agents from triggers, schedules, integrations, and APIs.
Run the `warp` command to start a conversation in any terminal emulator, over SSH, or on a machine where the Warp app isn't installed.
